title: Ripple adds support for institutions to access RWA perpetual swaps
message_html: Ripple adds support for institutions to access RWA perpetual swaps ...
snippet: Ripple, a leading provider of blockchain solutions across traditional and digital finance, today announced that Ripple Prime has launched support for real-world asset (RWA) perpetual swaps.
